description: This bar chart, titled “Mapping the Minds of LLMs: A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM,” illustrates the token count for two categories—“Reasoning” (orange) and “Demonstration” (blue)—across five discrete values on the horizontal axis labeled “Number of Shots,” which ranges from 0 to 4. The vertical axis, labeled “Token Count,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 7000, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 1000. Each bar represents a specific number of shots and is composed of two stacked segments: the orange “Reasoning” portion and the blue “Demonstration” portion on top. For the “0” shot category, there is only an orange bar with a value of 6393, as the “Demonstration” segment is absent. For the “1” shot category, the orange “Reasoning” segment has a value of 4141 (implied by the -1952 annotation above the blue segment), and the blue “Demonstration” segment is annotated with -1952. For the “2” shot category, the orange “Reasoning” segment has a value of 4855 (implied by the -1613 annotation above the blue segment), and the blue “Demonstration” segment is annotated with -1613. For the “3” shot category, the orange “Reasoning” segment has a value of 5000 (implied by the -1040 annotation above the blue segment), and the blue “Demonstration” segment is annotated with -1040. For the “4” shot category, the orange “Reasoning” segment has a value of 4621 (implied by the -1379 annotation above the blue segment), and the blue “Demonstration” segment is annotated with -1379. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in ascending order of the “Number of Shots” on the horizontal axis. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color coding and the red annotations indicating the value of the blue segment above each bar.
